title: The Programme Based Budget 2025/2026 (County Government of Nyamira, July 2025)

nextExpected.what: Nyamira's budget for FY2026/27, which the County Assembly is to approve by 30 June (PFM Act s.131(1))

note: Its columns are headed 'Printed Estimates 2025/2026', so its figures are shown at the estimates stage. The county also posted a stamped scan of the same document on 24 Sep 2026, with a letter of 29 Jul 2025 forwarding it to the Clerk of the County Assembly 'in accordance with Section 135' of the PFM Act; section 135 is about supplementary budgets, so the letter does not show that these figures were approved. Its total, KSh 8,646,298,391, equals the FY2025/26 budget the Controller of Budget reports.

title: Fourth Quarter Budget Implementation Report FY 2025/2026 (County Government of Nyamira, July 2026)

nextExpected.what: The first quarter report for FY2026/27, which the County Treasury publishes not later than one month after the quarter ends (PFM Act s.166(4))

note: The county's own report. Its spending for FY2025/26 (KSh 7,105,627,509) is higher than the Controller of Budget's (KSh 7,009.26 million); both are shown with their sources.
